newsitem.title: LEBANON: GAMES-Qatar leads in gold medals in Pan Arab Games.
newsitem.headline: GAMES-Qatar leads in gold medals in Pan Arab Games.

text.p: Qatar on Tuesday led the Pan Arab Games in Beirut in gold medals, upstaging Maghreb states who led the competition on Monday.
Qatar captured five gold medals on Monday.

The Gulf Arab state's Saad al-Kawari won the 100-metre in 10.40 seconds. In the 110-metre hurdle, Mubarak Mubarak swept to victory in 14.17 seconds. Ibrahim Saeed won the 400-metre in 45.50 seconds. Ahmed Abdel-Karim jumped 5.22 metres to win the pole vault.
Qatar's Bilal Mubarak on Sunday won the prized gold in the shot put.
The Pan Arab Games information committee has so far only provided results for the first two days of competition which began in the Lebanese capital on Sunday.

Morocco trailed behind Qatar with two golds in women's events. On Monday, the North African state's Nadia Zatwani ran the 400-metre in 54.98 seconds. Zahra Bouaziz won the 5,000-metre heat in 16 minutes and 01.68 seconds.
Moroccan athletes on Sunday grabbed gold medals in the men's 10,000 metres and the men's long jump.
Algeria's Baya Rahouli has grabbed the limelight, winning the women's 100-metre and 100-metre hurdle. She won women's long jump on Sunday.
